📋 考试结构（先看清考什么）
  • Term 1（闭卷机考，65 分钟）：30 道 Excel 选择题 ＋ Word 实操（按指令排版）；平时还有每周 Theory Quiz（Moodle 随机 5 题 / 5 分钟，Week 2 起仅一次机会）。
  • Term 2：Advanced Excel 练习考（30 分钟 30 题 Moodle 选择题，占 Term 2 计算分 20% / 总评 10%）＋ Media Presentation 小组课程作业（规划文档 Planning Document ＋ 制作产出 Plan and Produce ＋ 反馈 Feedback）。

1 Course & Assessment Overview（课程与评估概览）

This block tests what makes up the Term 1 assessment and the format/timing of the Final Exam（本块考 Term 1 评估由哪几部分组成、Final Exam 的形式与时长）; it is conceptual, so multiple-choice questions may ask directly（属于概念题，选择题会直接考）.

Assessment Structure（评估三大块） 常考

  • Assessment 1: Computing Weekly Theory Quizzes (the weekly theory quizzes across Weeks 1–6)（每周理论小测）.
  • Assessment 2: Tutorial Performance (in-class/tutorial participation, including assessable activities)（课堂/辅导课表现，含可评估活动）.
  • Assessment 3: Term 1 Final Exam (a formal closed-book final exam)（正式闭卷期末考）.
  • The exact weighting for each term and stream is set by the Course Outline; the lecture slides do not list specific percentages（各 term、各 stream 的具体权重以 Course Outline 为准，课件不列具体百分比）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice and short conceptual questions, possibly asking which assessments Term 1 has or what the Final Exam contains（选择题、简答概念题，可能问 Term 1 有哪些评估、Final Exam 包含什么）.
⚠️ Pitfall: treating the Weekly Theory Quiz as part of the Final Exam（把 Weekly Theory Quiz 当成 Final Exam 的一部分）; they are counted separately — weekly quizzes are regular theory marks, while the Final Exam is the closed-book exam（每周小测是平时理论成绩，Final Exam 是期末闭卷考）.

Computing Theory Quiz（理论小测） 常考

  • Each week, based on that week's lecture, you complete 5 randomised Moodle multiple-choice questions (randomised, so each person gets a different set)（每周基于当周 lecture 内容，在 Moodle 做 5 道随机选择题）.
  • Time limit is 5 minutes; the quiz auto-closes once started（限时 5 分钟，开始后自动计时关闭）.
  • Weeks 2–6 allow only one attempt (one attempt only); Week 1 allows multiple attempts and takes the highest score to let you learn the process（Week 2–6 仅一次尝试；Week 1 可多次尝试，取最高分熟悉流程）.
  • There are 6 quizzes in total (Weeks 1–6), forming the Term 1 Computing Theory mark（共 6 次，总分构成 Term 1 Computing Theory 成绩）.
  • Artificial Intelligence Tools are not allowed（禁止使用 AI 工具）.
📝 Exam format: online Moodle multiple-choice, 5 questions / 5 minutes（Moodle 在线选择题，5 题/5 分钟）.
⚠️ Pitfall: from Week 2 there is only one attempt, so you must watch recordings and review materials beforehand（Week 2 起只有一次机会，考前必须看录像、复习材料）; do not assume you can redo it（误以为还能重做）.

Term 1 Final Exam Format（期末考形式） 必考

  • Formal closed-book exam, 65 minutes（正式闭卷考，65 分钟）.
  • Held in the Exam Block after Week 13（时间在 Week 13 之后的 Exam Block）.
  • Two parts: 30 Excel Multiple Choice Questions plus a Word Processing Practical Task (format a Word document by following instructions)（30 道 Excel 选择题＋按指令格式化 Word 文档的实操）.
  • Artificial Intelligence Tools are not allowed here either（同样禁止使用 AI 工具）.
📝 Exam format: Excel multiple-choice (30 questions) plus a Word practical task (format step by step)（Excel 选择题 30 题＋Word 实操）.
⚠️ Pitfall: assuming the Final Exam tests only Word or only Excel（以为只考 Word 或只考 Excel）; in fact both are tested, and Word is a follow-instructions practical task, not multiple-choice（两者都考，且 Word 是按指令实操而非选择题）.

2 Microsoft 365 Basics（Microsoft 365 基础）

This block covers pre-exam preparation: install Office 365 and set language/region/time to Australian standards（本块考考前准备：装好 Office 365、把语言/地区/时间设为澳大利亚标准）; a required prerequisite, and multiple-choice questions may test the settings（属必做前提，选择题可能考设置项）.

Installing Office 365（下载与安装） 了解

  • You must use the Office 365 (Microsoft 365) version of Word / Excel / PowerPoint that is downloaded and installed on your own device（必须使用已下载并安装在本机设备上的 Microsoft 365 版本）.
  • Phones and tablet computers are not suitable for in-class participation or practical activities（手机、平板不适合课堂参与与实操活动）.
  • Software and device requirements are listed on Moodle under Device and Software Requirements（软件与设备要求见 Moodle）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice, possibly asking which Office version to use or device requirements（选择题，可能问应使用哪个版本的 Office、设备要求）.
⚠️ Pitfall: using the web version or an older Office edition to sit the exam（用网页版或旧版 Office 应试）; the exam environment requires locally installed Microsoft 365（考试环境要求本机安装的 Microsoft 365）.

Language, Region & Time Settings（语言/地区/时间设置） 必考

  • Set Language to English (Australian)（把 Language 设为 English (Australian)）.
  • Set Region to Australia（把 Region 设为 Australia）.
  • Adjust Time Settings accordingly to the Australian time zone/format（相应调整 Time Settings 为澳大利亚时区/格式）.
  • The slides stress this repeatedly (Week 1 overview and every weekly learning guide) so that spelling, dates and function behaviour match the exam environment（课件在多处反复强调，目的是保证拼写、日期、函数行为与考试环境一致）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice, often asking to set Language to English (Australian) and Region to Australia（常考语言应设为 English (Australian)、地区设为 Australia）.
⚠️ Pitfall: setting English (US) or English (UK) instead（设成 English (US) 或 English (UK)）; date/spelling differences affect Word's spell check and Excel behaviour, and the exam explicitly requires Australian（考试明确要求 Australian）.

3 PowerPoint Presentation Design（PowerPoint 演示设计）

This block tests presentation design principles: purpose & audience, text readability, contrast, alignment, consistency and the slide master, plus spotting layout problems（本块考演示设计原则：目的与受众、文字可读性、对比、对齐、一致性、slide master 母版，以及识别排版错误）; both multiple-choice and practical tasks are involved（选择题与实操都会涉及）.

Purpose & Audience（明确目的与受众） 必考

  • First decide the purpose: Inform/Announce, Instruct/Educate, Inspire/Motivate, or Persuade（先想清楚演示目的：告知、指导教学、激励、说服）.
  • Then tailor language and depth to the audience, ensuring it is appropriately aimed at the target readers（再针对受众调整语言与内容深度）.
  • A good presentation: content supports what the speaker says, text is clear from a distance, slides are not overcrowded, images fit the content, charts are simple, and flows use SmartArt or similar visuals（好的演示：内容支撑演讲者所说、文字清晰可从远处读、幻灯片不堆满、图片贴合内容、图表简洁、流程用 SmartArt 等可视化）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice / short answer, asking what to determine before designing or which category a slide's purpose belongs to（问设计前先确定什么、某幻灯片目的属于哪类）.
⚠️ Pitfall: jumping to layout before clarifying purpose and audience（跳過目的与受众直接做版式）; a wrong audience leads to wrong wording and depth（受众不对会导致用词、深度全错）.

Text Readability（文字可读性：字体与字数） 常考

  • For best on-screen readability use sans serif fonts such as Arial, Century Gothic, Verdana; serif fonts (e.g. Times New Roman) read worse on screen（屏幕可读性最佳用 sans serif 字体；serif 屏幕可读性较差）.
  • Font size should be large enough to read from a distance; prefer about 1.1 line spacing（字号要大到可从远处看清；多用 1.1 倍行距）.
  • For a speaker-led presentation, list only key points per slide: at most 6 points, one to two lines each, one topic per slide, one-line titles; use short paragraphs only for online/email versions（有演讲者时每页只列要点：最多 6 点、每点一到两行、一个主题一页、标题只一行；在线/邮件版才用短段落）.
  • Avoid ALL CAPITALS and underlining (hard to read); emphasise keywords sparingly with bold / italic / shadow; use at most 2–3 fonts overall, keeping title and body styles consistent（避免全大写与下划线；关键词用 bold/italic/shadow 少量强调；全篇最多 2–3 种字体）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice, asking which font is clearer on screen or the max points per slide（考哪种字体屏幕更清晰、每页最多几点）.
⚠️ Pitfall: using ALL CAPITALS or underlining for emphasis; cramming a long paragraph or over 6 points on one slide; mixing more than 3 fonts（用全大写或下划线强调；一页塞长段落或超 6 点；混用超过 3 种字体）.

Contrast（对比） 常考

  • High contrast aids reading most: light background with dark text stays clear even far back in a lecture hall（浅色背景配深色文字在讲堂远处也清晰）.
  • Use no more than 2–3 colours; muted colours for serious/complex content, brighter colours for relaxed/fun content（颜色不超过 2–3 种；严肃内容用柔和色，轻松内容可用 brighter 色）.
  • When visualising data, keep charts simple and mark the point of focus with an arrow or outline（数据可视化时保持图表简洁，用箭头或轮廓标出焦点）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice, testing high-contrast colour principles or the colour-count limit（考高对比配色原则、颜色数量限制）.
⚠️ Pitfall: dark text on a dark background (low contrast); using more than 3 colours and creating clutter（深底深字、低对比；用超过 3 种颜色导致杂乱）.

Alignment（对齐） 常考

  • Text and graphics should align to the margin or centre, kept uniform（文本/图形要對齐到页边或中心，保持统一）.
  • Paragraphs may be set to justified so both edges are neat（段落可设 justified 两端对齐）.
  • Use the slide layout placeholders to keep alignment uniform; avoid dragging placeholders freely, which causes the title to jump between slides（使用 slide layout 的占位符统一对齐，避免随意拖动占位符导致跳页）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice / practical, testing alignment options or why you should not drag placeholders（考对齐方式、为何不要乱拖占位符）.
⚠️ Pitfall: placing elements arbitrarily without alignment; dragging the title placeholder so the title position jumps on every slide（元素随意摆放不对齐；拖动标题占位符使每页标题位置跳动）.

Consistency & Slide Master（一致性与 slide master 母版） 必考

  • Use slide layouts to keep placeholder positions uniform and achieve a consistent look（用 slide layouts 保持占位符位置统一）.
  • To change every slide at once (add objects, change title style/position, change paragraph spacing), use the slide master (View → Slide Master)（要一次性改所有幻灯片，用 slide master）.
  • Key limitation: if a slide has direct formatting (e.g. changed font colour/style), slide master changes will not override it（若某张幻灯片已做 direct formatting，slide master 的改动不会覆盖它）.
  • Transitions, if used in several places, should stay consistent (same or similar effect)（切换若多处使用，应保持一致）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice / practical, asking what to use to change all slides uniformly or why the master does not take effect（考统一改全部幻灯片用什么、母版不生效的原因）.
⚠️ Pitfall: forgetting that the master cannot override already directly-formatted slides; assuming master changes always apply globally（忘记母版无法覆盖已直接格式化的幻灯片；误以为改母版一定全局生效）.

Animations & Transitions（动画与切换） 了解

  • Animations act on content within a slide (text, graphics, shapes) to highlight points, prevent the audience reading ahead, or reveal items one by one（animations 作用于单页内容，用于突出重点、防止观众先读、逐条出现）.
  • Use subtle animations such as appear or fade; avoid fly-in/zoom that distract（用 subtle 动画如 appear、fade，避免飞入/缩放等分散注意）.
  • Transitions act on the whole-slide change, giving a visual cue for topic changes; not every slide needs one, but if used, keep them consistent（transitions 作用于整页切换，提供话题转换的视觉提示，用则保持一致）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice, testing the difference between animation and transition or that animations should be moderate（考 animation 与 transition 区别、动画应适度）.
⚠️ Pitfall: confusing animation with transition (the former targets content, the latter targets the whole slide)（把 animation 与 transition 混淆）.

Common Layout Problems（常见排版错误：识别问题） 必考

  • Identify problem types from example slides: COLOUR (poor contrast / messy palette), TEXT (small font, ALL CAPITALS, too much), LAYOUT (crowded, misaligned), ANIMATION (overly fancy), and GRAPHICS (irrelevant or low-quality images)（能从示例幻灯片中识别四类问题：对比差、字小全大写过多、拥挤不对齐、过度花哨、无关或低质图片）.
  • Images should be simple, high-resolution and content-relevant; crop away irrelevant details when needed; clip art must directly fit the information（图片应简洁、高清、与内容相关，必要时裁剪；clip art 须直接贴合信息）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice / short answer, showing a bad slide and asking which category the problem belongs to（给一张坏幻灯片让你指出问题属于哪类）.
⚠️ Pitfall: spotting only one error and missing multiple categories (colour + text + layout often appear together)（只看出一个错误而漏掉多类）.

4 MS Word Basics & Document Structure（MS Word 基础与文档结构）

This block tests Word concepts, document components, styles and heading levels（本块考 Word 概念、文档组成要素、styles 样式与 headings 标题层级）; it underpins later long-document and TOC work, tested in both multiple-choice and practical（是后续长文档与 TOC 的基础，选择题与实操都考）.

Word Concepts & Document Structure（Word 概念与文档结构） 了解

  • Word is the word-processing app in Microsoft 365, used to produce documents suitable for academic submission（Word 是 Microsoft 365 中的文字处理应用，用于产出适合学术提交的文档）.
  • Core interface elements: ribbon, cursor / insertion point, selection, clipboard, and the quick access toolbar（核心界面元素：ribbon 功能区、光标/插入点、选区、剪贴板、快速访问工具栏）.
  • Document elements: margins (blank space between content and page edges), alignment, graphic, table (specify rows/columns or convert existing text to a table), text wrap (how text flows around an image, default in line with text), header / footer（文档要素：页边距、对齐、图形、表格、文字绕图方式、页眉/页脚）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice, testing definitions of margins / alignment / text wrap etc.（考 margins/alignment/text wrap 等术语定义）.
⚠️ Pitfall: confusing margin with indentation; the default graphic wraps in line with text rather than around it（把 margin 与 indentation 混淆；默认图形是 in line with text 而非四周绕排）.

Short-Document Workflow & Structure（短文档工作流与结构） 常考

  • Process: 1 gather materials and create a folder → 2 create and save the document, add formatted text/images/tables → 3 polish and proofread, save as .docx, export PDF if needed（流程：收集素材建文件夹 → 创建保存文档、添加格式化文本/图像/表格 → 润色校对、存 .docx、按需导出 PDF）.
  • Short/simple documents may be formatted directly (direct formatting); long/complex documents should use styles for efficiency（短文档可直接格式化；长文档应使用 styles）.
  • View aids: View > Ruler shows the ruler; double-clicking the ruler opens Page Setup; Home > Paragraph > Show/Hide reveals formatting marks（视图辅助：View > Ruler 显示标尺；双击标尺开 Page Setup；Home > Paragraph > Show/Hide 显示格式标记）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice / practical, testing the standard document-creation flow or the role of the ruler / show-marks（考创建文档的标准流程、标尺/显示标记的作用）.
⚠️ Pitfall: still formatting a long document paragraph by paragraph, making later uniform changes impossible（长文档仍逐段直接格式化，导致后期无法统一修改）.

Styles（样式：应用与修改） 必考

  • A style is a bundle of formats applied to text at once (font, colour, paragraph, line spacing, etc.)（style 是多种格式的组合，可一次套用到文本）.
  • Apply: first pick a style set from the Design tab, then use Home > Styles gallery to apply Normal, Heading 1, etc.（应用：先 Design 选项卡选 style set，再到 Home > Styles gallery 套用）.
  • Modify: right-click a style in the Styles gallery → Modify; the change applies to all text using that style; you can also swap the whole style set from the Design tab to change the document（修改：右键样式 → Modify，改动应用到所有套用该样式的文本；也可从 Design 选项卡换 style set）.
  • Key limitation: after direct formatting on text, changing the style will not update it; use Home > Font > Clear All Formatting to remove it（对文本做了 direct formatting 后，改样式不会更新它；可用 Clear All Formatting 清除）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice / practical, testing how to change the whole document's format uniformly or why one paragraph does not follow the style（考如何统一改全文格式、为何某段不随样式变）.
⚠️ Pitfall: assuming a style change overrides directly-formatted text; missing the right-click Modify step and only changing a single paragraph（以为改样式能覆盖直接格式化文本；漏掉右键 Modify 而只改单段）.

Heading Levels（标题层级） 必考

  • Use Heading 1 / Heading 2 / Heading 3 to build hierarchy, the basis of an automatic table of contents（用 Heading 1/2/3 建立层级，是自动目录的基础）.
  • After applying heading styles, you can generate a clickable, interactive table of contents in one click（套用标题样式后可一键生成基于标题的交互式目录）.
  • Modifying a Heading style synchronises the appearance of all same-level headings, keeping the document consistent（修改 Heading 样式会同步改变所有同级标题外观）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice / practical, testing what an automatic TOC depends on or the role of heading levels（考自动目录依赖什么、标题层级作用）.
⚠️ Pitfall: manually enlarging font size for headings instead of using Heading styles, so an automatic TOC cannot be generated（用手动加大字号当标题而不用 Heading 样式，导致无法自动生成目录）.

5 Advanced Word Formatting（Word 高级排版）

This block tests page setup, section breaks, headers/footers and page numbers, and the automatic table of contents（本块考页面设置、分节符、页眉页脚与页码、自动目录）; it is the Word practical core of the Final Exam — must-know and highly step-based（是 Final Exam 的 Word 实操核心，必考且步骤性强）.

Page Setup（页面设置） 常考

  • Set margins: Layout tab > Page Setup group > Margins > Custom Margins; or double-click the grey ruler area to open the Page Setup dialog（设置页边距：Layout 选项卡 > Page Setup 组 > Margins > Custom Margins；或双击标尺灰区开 Page Setup）.
  • Common requirements: 2 cm all around, or 2 cm top/bottom and 2.5 cm left/right, depending on the instruction（常见要求：上下左右 2cm，或上下 2cm、左右 2.5cm）.
  • You can also set paper size and layout in Page Setup（也可在 Page Setup 中设纸张、版式等）.
📝 Exam format: Word practical, set margins to the specified value per instruction（按指令把页边距设为指定值）.
⚠️ Pitfall: only viewing in print preview without actually changing Page Setup; swapping the left/right and top/bottom values（只在打印预览里看而没真正改 Page Setup；左右与上下数值搞反）.

Section Break（分节符） 必考

  • Role: split the document into sections so each can have independent headers/footers and page numbers（作用：把文档分成不同 section，使各部分可有独立页眉/页脚与页码）.
  • Insert: place the cursor, then Layout tab > Page Setup group > Breaks dropdown > under Section Breaks choose Next Page（插入：Layout 选项卡 > Breaks 旁箭头 > Section Breaks 下选 Next Page）.
  • Typical use: insert a section break after the cover and contents pages so the body starts numbering from page 1 while earlier pages have no number（典型用法：封面页+目录页之后插入分节符，使正文从第 1 页开始编号、前面不编号）.
📝 Exam format: Word practical, testing how to make one section's page numbers start at 1 and earlier pages have none（考如何让某节页码从 1 开始、前几页无页码）.
⚠️ Pitfall: using a page break instead of a section break, so headers/footers cannot be set independently; forgetting to break Link to Previous after splitting（用 page break 而非 section break；分节后忘了断开 Link to Previous）.

Header / Footer & Page Numbers（页眉页脚与页码） 必考

  • Enter the footer: double-click the bottom of the page, or Insert > Footer > Edit Footer（进入页脚：双击页面底部，或 Insert > Footer > Edit Footer）.
  • After splitting: in the Header & Footer tab's Navigation group, make sure Link to Previous is not highlighted, so this section is independent（分节后：确保 Link to Previous 未高亮，才能本节独立）.
  • Add page numbers: Header & Footer group > Page Number > Current Position > choose Page X of Y（加页码：Page Number > Current Position > 选 Page X of Y）.
  • To start a section at 1: select the page number > Page Number > Format Page Numbers > choose Start at and enter 1（让某节从 1 开始：Format Page Numbers > Start at 填 1）.
  • To show this section's page count rather than the whole document's: Insert group > Document Info / Quick Parts > Field → Categories: Numbering, Field names: SectionPages, format 1,2,3…（显示本节页数：Insert 组 > Quick Parts > Field → Numbering / SectionPages）.
  • You can add the File Name or File Path as an automatic field（可加 File Name 或 File Path 作为自动字段）.
📝 Exam format: Word practical, testing inserting Page X of Y, starting page numbers at 1 after a section break, and showing the section's page count（考插入 Page X of Y、分节后页码从 1 开始、显示本节页数）.
⚠️ Pitfall: Link to Previous still linked after splitting, so changing one section changes all; using whole-document page count instead of SectionPages; forgetting Format Page Numbers → Start at 1（分节后 Link to Previous 仍连着；页码用全文页数而非 SectionPages；忘记设 Start at 1）.

Table of Contents（目录） 必考

  • Prerequisite: the document already uses Heading 1/2/3 styles（前提：文档已用标题样式）.
  • Generate: place the cursor on the contents page, References tab > Table of Contents group > choose Automatic Table 1 (based on headings, clickable for navigation)（生成：References 选项卡 > Table of Contents 组 > 选 Automatic Table 1）.
  • Update: click Update Table on the TOC (or right-click) → choose Update entire table; update whenever headings change, are added/removed, or content shifts pages（更新：点 Update Table → Update entire table；改动标题、增删标题或内容换页后都要更新）.
📝 Exam format: Word practical, testing auto-generating a TOC and updating the whole table（考自动生成目录、更新整张目录）.
⚠️ Pitfall: inserting a TOC without heading styles gives an empty result; updating page numbers only, not the entire table, so new headings are missing（没用标题样式就插目录结果为空；只更新页码不更新整表）.

Cover Page & Section-Break Comprehensive Task（封面页与分节综合实战） 常考

  • Insert a cover page: place the cursor at the document start, Insert > Text group > Object dropdown > Text from File, choose the cover file; add a page break below it（插入封面页：Insert > Object 箭头 > Text from File，选封面页文件；其下加 page break）.
  • The combined order is often: set margins → choose style set → apply heading styles → insert cover page → generate TOC → insert section break (Next Page) → set footer page numbers starting at 1 with no numbers before → update TOC → save and preview（综合顺序：设页边距 → 选 style set → 套标题样式 → 插封面页 → 生成 TOC → 插分节符 → 设页脚页码从 1 开始、前页无号 → 更新 TOC → 存盘预览）.
  • Use a page break to avoid a heading stranded at the bottom of a page; Insert > Cover Page is also an option（用 page break 避免标题孤行在页底；必要时 Insert > Cover Page）.
📝 Exam format: comprehensive Word practical, completing a long document with cover, TOC, and sectioned page numbers per instruction（Word 实操综合题，按指令完成含封面、目录、分节页码的长文档）.
⚠️ Pitfall: the cover/contents pages also carrying page numbers (they should be unnumbered); wrong section order (inserting TOC before the section break merges it into the body section)（封面页/目录页也带页码；分节顺序错：先插 TOC 再分节导致目录被并入正文节）.

S6 Computer & Internet Basics（计算机与互联网基础）

This block tests computer components and internet fundamentals, mainly multiple-choice, fill-in and ordering questions, forming a large share of the theory paper and the theoretical base for later office-software work（本块考计算机组成与互联网常识，以选择题、填空/排序为主，约占理论题较大比重，是后续办公软件操作的理论底座）.

Hardware vs Software（硬件与软件的区别） 必考

  • Hardware: the physical, tangible parts of a computer — CPU, memory, hard drive, keyboard, monitor（hardware：计算机的物理组成部分，如 CPU、内存、硬盘、键盘、显示器）.
  • Software: the programs and instructions that direct the hardware, divided into system software (e.g. OS) and application software (e.g. Word, browser)（software：指挥硬件工作的程序，分系统软件与应用软件）.
  • The OS is system software, the bridge between hardware and application software（操作系统 OS 属于 system software，是硬件与应用软件之间的桥梁）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice testing whether a device/program is hardware or software; short answer on their relationship（选择题考区分 hardware/software；简答题考二者关系）.
⚠️ Pitfall: misclassifying the OS as hardware, or treating peripherals like the mouse or printer as software（把 OS 误归为 hardware；把鼠标、打印机当成 software）.

Four Computer Functions & Core Components（计算机四大功能与核心组件） 必考

  • Four functions: input, processing, storage, output（四大功能：输入、处理、存储、输出）.
  • CPU (Central Processing Unit): the core that executes instructions and calculations; performance is measured by clock speed (unit GHz)（CPU：执行指令与运算的核心，性能看 clock speed）.
  • RAM (Random Access Memory): temporarily holds running data, lost when power is off, readable and writable（RAM：临时存放运行中的数据，断电即丢失，可读写）.
  • ROM (Read-Only Memory): permanently holds startup programs, generally not freely rewritable（ROM：固化存放启动程序，一般不可随意改写）.
  • The motherboard connects and coordinates all components（motherboard 连接并协调各部件）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice matching a function to a component; fill-in comparing RAM/ROM traits（选择题考某功能对应哪个部件；填空考 RAM/ROM 特性对比）.
⚠️ Pitfall: confusing RAM with ROM — remember RAM is temporary and read/write, ROM is read-only and fixed; both are memory but play different roles（混淆 RAM 与 ROM）.

Input / Output / Storage Devices（输入/输出/存储设备） 常考

  • Input devices: keyboard, mouse, track pad, scanner, microphone, camera（输入设备）.
  • Output devices: monitor, printer, speaker（输出设备）.
  • Storage devices: HDD, SSD, USB flash, optical disc, cloud storage; split into internal and external/removable storage（存储设备：分内部存储与外部/可移动存储）.
  • Storage is for long-term data retention, unlike RAM's temporary storage（存储用于长期保留数据，与 RAM 的临时存储不同）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice classifying a device as input/output/storage; scanner and printer are often contrasted（考某设备属于哪一类；常把 scanner、printer 拿来做区分）.
⚠️ Pitfall: simply classifying touchscreens or cameras that do both input and output; mixing up storage with RAM（把触摸屏、摄像头简单归类；把 storage 与 RAM 混为一谈）.

Operating System (OS)（操作系统） 常考

  • The OS manages hardware resources and software execution, providing the interface (GUI) between user and computer（OS 管理硬件资源与软件运行，提供 GUI 图形界面）.
  • Responsibilities: process management, memory management, file management, device management, user interface（职责：进程、内存、文件、设备管理、用户接口）.
  • Common OSes: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS（常见 OS）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on the OS's role; short answer on whether the OS is system or application software（考 OS 的作用；简答题考 OS 属于哪类 software）.
⚠️ Pitfall: treating the browser or Word as part of the OS; forgetting that the OS itself is software（把浏览器、Word 当成 OS 的一部分；忽略 OS 本身也是 software）.

Binary & Data Storage Units（二进制与数据存储单位换算） 必考

  • Data is represented in binary, using only 0 and 1; one character is typically encoded as one byte（数据以 binary 表示，一个字符通常编码为一个 byte）.
  • bit: the smallest data unit, a single 0 or 1（bit：最小数据单位）.
  • byte: 1 byte equals 8 bits, commonly used to represent one character（byte：1 byte = 8 bit）.
  • Capacity progression: bit → byte → KB → MB → GB → TB, with adjacent steps roughly ×1024 (1 KB ≈ 1024 bytes)（容量单位递进：相邻约按 1024 倍换算）.
  • Screens use pixels to represent image points; resolution is the number of pixels per unit area（屏幕用 pixel 表示图像点，resolution 指单位面积的像素数量）.
📝 Exam format: unit-conversion multiple-choice (e.g. how many bytes equal 1 KB); fill-in on how many bits in 1 byte（单位换算选择题；填空考 1 byte = 几位）.
⚠️ Pitfall: mixing up bit and byte (8× apart); using 1000 instead of 1024 for conversions; treating resolution as a storage unit（把 bit 与 byte 搞混；单位换算误用 1000 而非 1024；把 resolution 当成存储单位）.

Internet, WWW & Browser（互联网与万维网、浏览器） 必考

  • internet: the globally interconnected computer-network infrastructure（互联网：全球互联的计算机网络基础设施）.
  • world wide web: an information system running on the internet, made of hypertext web pages, accessed via a browser（万维网：运行在互联网之上的信息系统，通过 browser 访问）.
  • Browsers locate resources by URL and transfer web pages via HTTP / HTTPS（浏览器用 URL 定位资源，通过 HTTP/HTTPS 协议传输网页）.
  • They are not synonyms: the WWW is just one service the internet provides（二者不是同义词：WWW 只是 internet 提供的一项服务）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on the difference between internet and WWW; fill-in on the protocol browsers use to fetch pages（考 internet 与 WWW 的区别；填空考浏览器访问网页所用协议）.
⚠️ Pitfall: treating internet and world wide web as synonyms; confusing the roles of URL and HTTP（把 internet 与 world wide web 当作同义词；混淆 URL 与 HTTP 的作用）.

Network Basics（网络基础） 常考

  • LAN (Local Area Network): a network over a small area (home, campus); WAN (Wide Area Network): a network across a large area, with the internet being the largest WAN（LAN：小范围局域网；WAN：跨大范围广域网，互联网是最大 WAN）.
  • ISP (Internet Service Provider): the operator connecting users to the internet（ISP：连接用户与互联网的运营商）.
  • IP address: a device's unique identifier on a network; a protocol such as TCP/IP defines communication rules（IP address：设备在网络中的唯一标识；protocol 如 TCP/IP 规定通信规则）.
  • client-server model: the client requests, the server responds（客户端—服务器模型：客户端请求、服务器响应）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on LAN vs WAN, ISP's role, client-server meaning（考 LAN 与 WAN 区别、ISP 作用、client-server 含义）.
⚠️ Pitfall: treating the ISP as a hardware device; confusing IP address with URL; assuming LAN and WAN differ only by distance with no architectural difference（把 ISP 当成硬件设备；混淆 IP address 与 URL；以为 LAN 与 WAN 仅按距离而无架构差异）.

File Management（文件管理） 了解

  • Organise files in a hierarchical folder structure for easy finding and backup（用文件夹层级结构组织文件，便于查找与备份）.
  • File extensions (e.g. .docx, .pdf, .xlsx) identify the file type and how to open it（文件扩展名标识文件类型与打开方式）.
  • Naming rules: clear meaning, avoid garbled names; the course requires assignment files to start with your ZID student number（命名规范：含义清晰；课程要求作业文件以 ZID 学号开头命名）.
  • Distinguish file location (local disk / cloud storage / mobile device) and keep reasonable backups（区分文件位置与合理备份）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on extension meanings; short answer on good file-naming/management habits（选择题考扩展名含义；简答题考良好文件命名/管理习惯）.
⚠️ Pitfall: thinking changing the extension changes the file type (it only changes the label); ignoring backups and losing data（以为改扩展名就能改文件类型；忽略备份导致数据丢失）.

S7 Website Evaluation: CARS（网站评价：CARS 标准）

This block tests how to judge whether website information is trustworthy, mainly multiple-choice and short-answer/case-analysis, a core point of information literacy（本块考如何判断网站信息是否可信，以选择题、简答/案例分析为主，是信息素养的核心考点）.

CARS Four Criteria Overview（CARS 四标准总览） 必考

  • Credibility: whether the source is trustworthy, with an author/organisation of reputation（可信度：信息来源是否值得信任）.
  • Accuracy: whether content is true, error-free, verifiable, without spelling or factual mistakes（准确性：内容是否真实、无误、有据可查）.
  • Reasonableness: whether the view is objective, balanced, logically consistent, without extreme or emotional wording（合理性：观点是否客观、平衡、逻辑自洽）.
  • Support: whether key claims are backed by citations, links or primary sources that can be checked（可查证：关键论断是否有引用、链接或原始资料支撑）.
  • Use the mnemonic CARS to check a site item by item; missing any one is a warning sign（可用记忆法 CARS 逐一核查网站：缺一项即需警惕）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on what each CARS letter means; short answer on evaluating a site with CARS（选择题考 CARS 各字母含义；简答题考用 CARS 评价某网站）.
⚠️ Pitfall: reading Reasonableness as simply good enough and skipping the bias check; missing Support's verifiability requirement（把 Reasonableness 误解为合理就好而忽略 bias 检查；漏掉 Support 的可查证要求）.

Source Authority & Bias（来源权威性与偏见） 必考

  • authority: whether the author has professional qualifications and the publisher is reliable (e.g. university, government agency, professional body)（权威性：作者是否具备专业资质、出版方是否可靠）.
  • peer review: content vetted by field experts, higher credibility, preferred for academic material（同行评审：由领域专家审核过的内容，可信度更高）.
  • bias: watch for commercial advertising tilt, political stance, conflicts of interest; heavily promotional or emotionally charged content should be discounted（偏见：注意商业广告倾向、政治立场、利益相关）.
  • Judge together with the course list's objectivity and currency（对照课程清单的 objectivity 与 currency 一并判断）.
📝 Exam format: case-analysis identifying a site's bias or judging its authority level（案例分析题考识别某网站的 bias 或判断其 authority 高低）.
⚠️ Pitfall: trusting authority just because it looks professional; ignoring bias from ads/sponsors; treating a personal blog as an academic source（仅凭看起来专业就认定权威；忽视广告/赞助方带来的 bias；把个人博客当学术来源）.

Domain Judgement & Currency（域名判断与时效性） 常考

  • Domain suffixes hint at source type: .edu (education/uni), .gov (government), .org (non-profit), .com (commercial)（域名后缀暗示来源类型）.
  • Generally .edu / .gov are more authoritative, but judge with the content itself, not the suffix alone（一般 .edu/.gov 权威性较高，但需结合内容本身判断）.
  • currency: whether the publish/update time is recent enough; stale data is unreliable in fast-changing fields（时效性：信息发布与更新时间是否够新）.
  • coverage and usability/design can also be part of the overall evaluation（覆盖度与易用性/设计也可纳入整体评价）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on what institution a domain represents; short answer on why you cannot judge by domain alone（选择题考某域名代表什么机构；简答题考为何不能只看域名）.
⚠️ Pitfall: assuming .com is always untrustworthy and .edu always trustworthy; ignoring whether information is outdated (currency)（认为 .com 一定不可信、.edu 一定可信；忽略信息是否过期）.

Practical: Evaluating a Site with a Checklist（实操：用清单评价网站） 常考

  • Score item by item against CARS or the course's seven standards (authority, accuracy, objectivity, currency, coverage, usability, design)（按 CARS 或课程七标准逐项打分）.
  • State a clear conclusion: can this site be used as an academic reference, and why（给出明确结论：该网站能否作为学术参考，理由是什么）.
  • Prefer material with peer review, clear sourcing and timely updates（优先选用带 peer review、来源清晰、更新及时的资料）.
📝 Exam format: given a site excerpt, write whether it can be cited and why, using the evaluation criteria (short answer / mini-essay)（给一个网站片段，要求用评价标准写出能否引用及原因）.
⚠️ Pitfall: only listing criteria without a conclusion; replacing CARS-based evidence with a feeling of something being off（只罗列标准不写结论；用感觉不对代替基于 CARS 的具体证据）.

S8 Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC)（系统开发生命周期 SDLC）

This block tests the whole process of an information system from initiation to operation, mainly stage-ordering, multiple-choice and short-answer/case-analysis, requiring accurate recall of stage order and each stage's deliverables（本块考信息系统从立项到运维的全过程，以阶段排序题、选择题、简答/案例分析为主，需准确记住阶段顺序与各阶段产出）.

SDLC Overview & Stage Order（SDLC 总览与阶段顺序） 必考

  • SDLC is a structured, repeatable, phased method for developing information systems, used to manage project risk and schedule（SDLC 是开发信息系统的结构化、可重复、分阶段方法）.
  • Standard seven-stage order: Planning → Analysis → Design → Development/Implementation → Testing → Implementation/Deployment → Operational Support & Security (i.e. Maintenance)（标准七阶段顺序）.
  • Use the seven stages in the Week 5 lecture for stage-order questions. Testing checks the system before formal implementation; Operational Support and Security begins once it is in use.（排序题按本周讲义的七阶段作答。正式实施前先测试；系统投入使用后进入运行支持与安全阶段。）
  • The order cannot be casually reversed, especially Testing before formal Deployment（顺序不可随意颠倒，尤其 Testing 在正式 Deployment 之前）.
📝 Exam format: stage-ordering (sort shuffled stages into correct order); multiple-choice on which stage an activity belongs to（阶段排序题；选择题考某活动属于哪个阶段）.
⚠️ Pitfall: mixing Analysis with Design (the former asks what is needed, the latter answers how to achieve it); neglecting Maintenance, thinking deployment is the end（把 Analysis 与 Design 混为一谈；忽视 Maintenance，以为部署即终点）.

What Each Stage Does & Delivers（各阶段做什么、产出什么） 必考

  • Planning: define the problem, goals, scope (in scope / out of scope), requirements and timeline; assess feasibility (operational, technical, time, budgetary) and decide go / no-go. Deliverable: project plan, feasibility report（规划：界定问题、目标、范围、需求与时间线；评估可行性，决定 go/no-go。产出：项目计划、可行性报告）.
  • Analysis: research business needs, interview stakeholders, map existing processes, write the analysis report, possibly build a prototype first. Deliverable: requirements/analysis report（分析：调研业务需求、访谈利益相关者、梳理现有流程、写分析报告，可能先做 prototype。产出：需求/分析报告）.
  • Design: determine system architecture, components, interface and flow, write the design document; focus on scalability, efficiency, reliability, security, maintainability, usability. Deliverable: design specification（设计：确定系统架构、组件、界面与流程，撰写设计文档。产出：设计说明书）.
  • Implementation (incl. Development): write code, build components, integrate the system, train users, go live. Deliverable: a runnable system（实施含开发：写代码、构建组件、集成系统、培训用户、正式上线。产出：可运行的系统）.
  • Testing: find and fix bugs, do functional/performance evaluation and UAT (User Acceptance Testing). Deliverable: a tested system（测试：发现并修复 bug，做功能/性能评估与 UAT 用户验收测试。产出：通过测试的系统）.
  • Maintenance (Operational Support & Security): continuously monitor performance, fix issues, apply security patches, add new features, across the system's whole life. Deliverable: a stably maintained system（维护：持续监控性能、修复问题、打安全补丁、加新功能。产出：稳定运维中的系统）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on a stage's deliverable (e.g. requirements report belongs to Analysis); short answer on the four feasibility elements（选择题考某阶段产出；简答考可行性四要素）.
⚠️ Pitfall: thinking testing happens only once (it includes multiple rounds and regression); assigning user training to Maintenance instead of Implementation; not remembering all four feasibility elements（认为测试只做一次；把培训用户归到 Maintenance 而非 Implementation；可行性四要素记不全）.

Implementation Strategies: Direct / Parallel / Phased / Pilot / Hybrid（实施策略） 常考

  • Direct (direct cut-over): old system shuts down one day, new goes live; fastest and cheapest but highest risk, no rollback（直接切换：旧系统某日关停、新系统启用；最快最省但风险最高）.
  • Parallel: old and new run simultaneously until the new is stable; low risk but costly and labour-heavy（并行：新旧系统同时运行直至新系统稳定；低风险但昂贵）.
  • Phased: switch gradually by module/department; low risk, eases training, but slow and costly（分阶段：按模块/部门逐步切换；风险低、便于培训，但慢且贵）.
  • Pilot: trial in one department/store first, then roll out fully; risk可控, suits multi-branch organisations（试点：先在一个部门/门店试用，再全面推广）.
  • Hybrid: combine the above as needed; flexible but complex to manage（混合：组合多种方式，灵活但管理复杂）.
  • Choice basis: risk tolerance, cost, system complexity, time, organisational capability（选择依据：风险承受度、成本、系统复杂度、时间、组织能力）.
📝 Exam format: case-analysis on which implementation strategy to choose for a given scenario and why（案例分析题考给定场景应选哪种实施策略及理由）.
⚠️ Pitfall: picking Direct for medical/emergency systems (should be Parallel); thinking Pilot equals full rollout; confusing Phased with Pilot's switch scope（医疗/急救系统误选 Direct；以为 Pilot 等于全面上线；混淆 Phased 与 Pilot 的切换范围）.

When to Use Waterfall vs Iterative（何时用瀑布模型/迭代模型） 常考

  • Waterfall (traditional SDLC): stages strictly sequential, each starting only after the previous completes; suits projects with clear, stable, manageable scope（瀑布：阶段严格顺序；适用于需求清晰、稳定、规模可控的项目）.
  • Iterative / Agile: repeat in cycles, delivering a usable increment each round, with requirements evolving; suits unclear, volatile or complex projects（迭代/敏捷：分阶段重复循环，每轮交付可用增量；适用于需求不明确、易变或复杂度高的项目）.
  • SDLC itself is a typical structured (waterfall) framework, but in practice often blended with iterative thinking（SDLC 本身是典型的结构化框架，但现实中常结合迭代思想）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice / short answer comparing the suitability conditions of waterfall vs iterative（选择题/简答题考瀑布与迭代的适用条件对比）.
⚠️ Pitfall: using pure waterfall when requirements are unclear (causes rework); thinking SDLC can only be waterfall, not iterative; treating iterative as having no planning（需求不清却用纯瀑布；以为 SDLC 只能瀑布、不能迭代；把 iterative 当成没有规划）.

S9 Excel Basics: Workbook, Worksheet, Cell and Range（Excel 基础概念与界面）

This block tests the core Excel hierarchy concepts and interface terms; it is the foundation for all later operations, and MCQs often probe definition discrimination and term matching（考查核心层级概念与界面术语，是后续操作的基础，选择题常考定义辨析与术语对应）.

Workbook / Worksheet / Cell / Range hierarchy（工作簿 / 工作表 / 单元格 / 区域 层级关系） 必考

  • workbook: an Excel file that can hold multiple worksheets; related tables may live in one file（工作簿：一个 Excel 文件，可含多张工作表）.
  • worksheet: a grid page built from columns (lettered) and rows (numbered); a single sheet inside a workbook（工作表：由列与行组成的表格页面）.
  • cell: the smallest data unit at the intersection of a row and a column; its address is column letter + row number, e.g. B2（单元格：行列交叉的最小单元，地址如 B2）.
  • range: a group of adjacent cells written as first cell:last cell, e.g. B2:G12; the colon marks a contiguous block（区域：相邻一组单元格，用冒号表示连续区域）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ / True-False — given a scenario decide workbook vs worksheet, or write a cell or range address（选择题 / 判断题：判断是工作簿还是工作表，或写出单元格与区域地址）.
⚠️ Pitfall: calling a workbook a worksheet; a range address must use a colon not a comma — commas only separate multiple non-adjacent areas inside a function（易错：把工作簿说成工作表；区域地址必须用冒号而非逗号，逗号只用于函数里分隔多个不相邻区域）.

Interface and core terms: ribbon, formula bar, fill handle（Excel 界面与核心术语：ribbon、编辑栏、填充柄） 常考

  • ribbon: the top command area with tabs (Home, Insert, Page Layout, etc.), organising tools into groups（功能区：顶部带选项卡的命令区）.
  • formula bar: the area that shows and edits the active cell's content; also used to view and build formulas（编辑栏：显示与编辑活动单元格内容）.
  • column headings are letters (A, B…Z, AA…) and row headings are numbers; the fill handle is the small square at a cell's bottom-right corner, used to drag-copy formulas or sequences（列标字母、行号数字；填充柄是单元格右下角小方块，拖拽复制公式或序列）.
  • hovering the mouse pointer over different interface elements changes its shape; on Mac, Fx / the Formula Builder helps build calculation functions（鼠标悬停改变指针形状；Mac 的 Fx 辅助建立函数）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ — name each interface region, or state what the formula bar, fill handle and ribbon do（选择题：识别界面区域名称或指出编辑栏、填充柄、ribbon 作用）.
⚠️ Pitfall: confusing the ribbon with the formula bar; forgetting the fill handle sits at the cell's corner, not its centre（易错：混淆 ribbon 与编辑栏；忘了填充柄在右下角而非中央）.

Formula vs Function（公式 vs 函数） 必考

  • every calculation starts with an equals sign = and follows BODMAS order (brackets, orders, multiply/divide, add/subtract)（所有计算以等号开头，遵循 BODMAS 运算顺序）.
  • formula: a calculation typed by hand using cell references and operators, e.g. =A1+A2+A3 or =(A1+A2)-A4（公式：手写的算式）.
  • function: a built-in Excel tool that performs an automatic calculation, with a name and arguments in parentheses, e.g. =SUM(A1:A5)（函数：预置自动计算工具，含名称与参数）.
  • functions can be nested inside formulas, e.g. =SUM(A1:A5)*5; a colon marks a contiguous range and a comma separates non-adjacent areas, e.g. =SUM(A1:A5,D1:D2)（公式中可嵌入函数；冒号表示连续区域，逗号分隔不相邻区域）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ — decide whether a calculation is a formula or a function; write a summing formula with a range（选择题：区分公式与函数；写出带区域的求和公式）.
⚠️ Pitfall: forgetting the leading =; assuming formulas and functions do not update together (they do, when a referenced cell changes); mistaking a range like A1:A5 for a function（易错：忘记等号开头；误以为公式函数不自动更新；把区域写法误当函数）.

S10 Data Entry, Editing, Formatting, Sorting and Filtering（数据录入 / 编辑 / 格式化 / 排序筛选）

This block tests practical data entry, formatting, sorting and filtering — high-frequency items in both Excel practical tasks and MCQs（考查数据录入、格式化、排序与筛选的实际操作，是高频考点）.

Data entry and editing techniques（数据录入与编辑技巧） 常考

  • enter constant values: text labels and numeric values; set the format first, then entered content adopts that format（录入常量：文本标签与数值；先设格式后录入）.
  • copy or fill with the fill handle or shortcuts: Ctrl+D fills down, Ctrl+R fills right; F2 edits the active cell（向下填充 Ctrl+D、向右填充 Ctrl+R、F2 编辑单元格）.
  • basic editing: insert rows / columns, adjust column width (double-click the heading's right border for best fit), and merge cells（插入行列、调整列宽、合并单元格）.
📝 Exam format: practical steps to enter and edit data; MCQ on what a shortcut does（实操题完成录入与编辑；选择题指出快捷键作用）.
⚠️ Pitfall: a narrow column shows ##### and looks like bad data, but it is only insufficient width; inserted items are whole rows/columns, not single cells（窄列出现 ##### 以为数据错；插入的是整行整列而非单个单元格）.

Number / Text / Date formats（数字 / 文本 / 日期格式） 必考

  • Currency or Accounting format for money (the course requires consistency across the table, Currency preferred); decimal places must be uniform（货币/会计格式用于金额，小数位数统一）.
  • Percentage format for ratios (e.g. change rate); set it after a ratio formula such as =（新价-原价）/原价 to two decimal places（百分比格式用于比率）.
  • text uses wrap text and alignment for layout; headings should align with the data below (numbers right, text left)（文本用自动换行与对齐；数字右对齐、文本左对齐）.
📝 Exam format: practical — set money to Currency with two decimals, set a ratio to Percentage（实操：金额设 Currency 两位小数、比率设百分比）.
⚠️ Pitfall: formatting changes only the display, not the value (the cell still holds the raw number); uneven decimals look unprofessional（格式只改显示不改数值；小数位不统一不专业）.

Cell formatting: font / borders / merge & center / alignment（单元格格式：字体 / 边框 / 合并居中 / 对齐） 必考

  • titles can be bolded, resized and shaded, then Merge & Center（标题可加粗、改字号、加底纹并合并居中）.
  • use Borders, e.g. All Borders, Bottom Double Border（用边框如全部框线、双线底边）.
  • alignment has horizontal (left / centre / right) and vertical (top / middle / bottom), which mean different things（水平与垂直对齐含义不同）.
📝 Exam format: practical — format titles and tables as required; MCQ distinguishing horizontal from vertical alignment（实操按要求格式化；选择题区分水平与垂直对齐）.
⚠️ Pitfall: a merged cell cannot be part of a sort range (sorting must exclude merged titles); confusing vertical middle align with horizontal centre（合并单元格不能作排序区域；把垂直居中误当水平居中）.

Sort: single-column and multi-column (Custom Sort)（排序：单列与多列自定义排序） 必考

  • single-column sort: place the cursor in the column, Home > Editing > Sort & Filter > ascending / descending (or right-click sort)（光标置于列，升序/降序）.
  • multi-column sort (Custom Sort): select the data area including headings, Add Level to add a secondary key, then set the order (e.g. State then Region)（多列：选中数据区，Add Level 增加次级关键字）.
  • before sorting, select the whole block and include the heading row, but the heading must not be a merged cell（整块选中含标题，标题不能是合并单元格）.
📝 Exam format: practical — sort by one column, or do a multi-level sort by two keys（实操：按某列排序或按两个关键字多级排序）.
⚠️ Pitfall: sorting only one column misaligns the rows (select the whole block first); sorting a merged-cell heading errors out（只排一列导致错位；合并单元格标题排序报错）.

Filter（筛选） 常考

  • select the table > Home > Editing > Filter; each column shows a dropdown arrow to tick the items to display（选中表，每列出现下拉箭头勾选项目）.
  • stack filters across columns to narrow the subset step by step; filtering only hides rows, does not change the data, and can be cleared to restore all（筛选只隐藏行不改变原数据，可清除恢复）.
  • charts change dynamically with filtering; to use a filtered view in a report, screenshot it first then revert（图表随筛选动态变化；用于报告需先截图再改回）.
📝 Exam format: practical — show only a chosen category and chart from it; MCQ on whether filtering changes the data（实操：只显示指定类别并作图；选择题判断筛选是否改变原数据）.
⚠️ Pitfall: assuming filtering deletes data (it only hides); a chart placed above the data gets covered by later filters, so place it below（以为筛选删除数据；图表应置于数据下方）.

Freeze panes（冻结窗格） 了解

  • freeze the top row / first column or panes to keep headings or key columns visible while scrolling a large table（滚动大表时保持标题或关键列可见）.
  • found under the View tab; helps compare headings against long data, and does not affect data or printing（位于 View 选项卡，不影响数据与打印）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ / practical — how to pin the heading row while scrolling a large table（选择题 / 实操：大表滚动时固定标题行）.
⚠️ Pitfall: the freeze position depends on the currently selected cell; a wrong selection misplaces the freeze（冻结位置取决于选中单元格，选错会错位）.

S11 Cell References: Relative, Absolute and Mixed（单元格引用：相对 / 绝对 / 混合）

This block is a core Excel calculation topic, testing the difference among relative, absolute and mixed references and how they change on fill — almost always examined（考查三类引用的区别与填充时的变化，几乎必考）.

Relative reference（相对引用） 必考

  • written as column letter + row number, e.g. A4（写法即列标+行号）.
  • when filled down / right, the reference shifts automatically with the formula's position, e.g. =A1+A2 becomes =A2+A3 when filled down（填充时随位置偏移）.
  • suits data that sits in the same relative position to the formula（适合引用与公式同相对位置的数据）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ — given a formula and a fill direction, decide how the reference changes after fill（选择题：给定公式与填充方向，判断引用变化）.
⚠️ Pitfall: using a relative reference where a cell should be fixed, making the whole column misalign（需要固定单元格却用相对引用导致整列错位）.

Absolute reference with $（绝对引用） 必考

  • add a dollar sign before both column and row, e.g. $A$4 or =$B$12*C4（列标与行号前都加 $）.
  • on fill the reference is pinned and always points to the same cell（填充时钉死不变）.
  • toggle shortcut: Windows F4 (laptops may need Fn), Mac Cmd+T（切换快捷键 F4 / Cmd+T）.
📝 Exam format: practical / MCQ — fix a reference that needs $ in a wrong formula; write a formula with an absolute reference（改错公式中应加 $ 的引用；写含绝对引用的公式）.
⚠️ Pitfall: locking only the column or only the row makes a mixed reference; forgetting to select the reference before pressing F4 puts $ in the wrong place（只锁列或行是混合引用；没先选中引用就按 F4）.

Mixed reference（混合引用） 常考

  • locks only a row or only a column: $A1 (lock column) or A$1 (lock row)（只锁行或只锁列）.
  • on fill the locked dimension stays fixed while the unlocked one shifts with position（锁定的维不变，未锁的维偏移）.
  • suits multiplication-table style calculations where one dimension is fixed and the other varies（适合一个维度固定、另一个变动的乘法表计算）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ — decide how $A1 and A$1 change when filled horizontally / vertically（选择题：判断横向/纵向填充时的变化）.
⚠️ Pitfall: confusing the lock direction of $A1 (column fixed) versus A$1 (row fixed)（混淆 $A1 与 A$1 的锁定方向）.

Why absolute references and the fill-shift rule（为何用绝对引用及填充变化规律） 必考

  • when a formula must repeatedly refer to the same parameter (postage, tax rate, unit price), absolute reference stops the reference drifting after fill（反复引用同一参数时用绝对引用避免跑偏）.
  • practice: place these fixed values in a reference area above/below the table and reference it with $ in the formula（在参考区放固定值，公式中用 $ 引用）.
  • advantages: visible (easy to check) and efficient (change one cell in the reference area and the whole table recalculates); in the Car Sales case B12 un-locked became B15, causing an error（可见、高效；Car Sales 案例中 B12 未锁变 B15 出错）.
📝 Exam format: practical — fix the reference error in the classic Car Sales case; explain why a cell must use absolute reference（修正常考案例 Car Sales 的引用错误；解释为何必须用绝对引用）.
⚠️ Pitfall: the reference area gets dragged by a relative reference (e.g. B12 fills to B15 pointing at a blank); changing the parameter without syncing the locked reference area（参考区被相对引用带偏；改参数未同步更新已锁引用区）.

S12 Excel Charts（Excel 图表制作）

This block tests chart-type choice, creation and element beautification — a key part of Excel MCQs and practical tasks（考查图表类型选择、创建与元素美化，是重点）.

Chart types and when to use them: column / bar / pie / line / scatter（图表类型及适用场景） 必考

  • column chart: compare values across categories with no required order; single or multiple series（柱形图：比较各类别大小，类别无需顺序）.
  • bar chart: horizontal columns; suited to long category names or many categories（条形图：横向，适合名称长或类别多）.
  • pie chart: show each part's share of the whole; single series only, non-negative values, almost no zeros, and fewer than about 7 categories（饼图：占整体比例，单一系列、非负、类别不超 7 个）.
  • line chart: show how data changes over time; category order matters（折线图：随时间变化趋势，顺序重要）.
  • scatter chart: analyse the relationship between two numeric variables; both X and Y axes are numeric and axis titles are required（散点图：两数值变量关系，两轴均数值且需轴标题）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ — given a data scenario choose the best chart type (share → pie, trend → line)（选择题：给出场景选图表类型）.
⚠️ Pitfall: using a column for a share (should be pie); forgetting axis titles on both scatter axes; more than 7 pie slices become unreadable（占比用柱形应为饼图；散点忘两轴标题；饼图超 7 类看不清）.

Chart elements: title / axes / legend / data labels（图表元素） 常考

  • Chart Title explains what the chart shows; a single series often needs no legend（图表标题说明内容；单一系列常不加图例）.
  • Axis: category axis (X) and value axis (Y); scatter needs titles on both axes（轴：类别轴 X 与数值轴 Y；散点两轴都需标题）.
  • Legend explains each data series; needed for multiple series（图例解释各系列，多系列时需要）.
  • Data Labels show values / percentages directly on the chart; Pie can show percentage with a legend key（数据标签直接标数值/百分比；饼图可显示百分比与图例键）.
  • add or remove elements via Chart Design > Add Chart Element（通过 Chart Design 添加或移除元素）.
📝 Exam format: practical — add title, legend and data labels; MCQ on what each element does（实操加标题图例数据标签；选择题判断各元素作用）.
⚠️ Pitfall: a pie with both a legend and data labels bearing a legend key duplicates information; a single-series column chart adding a legend is redundant（饼图图例与含图例键标签重复；单一系列柱形图多此一举加图例）.

How to choose the right chart type（如何选对图表类型） 必考

  • comparing sizes without emphasising order → column / bar（比较大小不强调顺序 → 柱形/条形）.
  • share / composition of a single whole → pie（占比/构成 → 饼图）.
  • trend / change over time → line（趋势/随时间变化 → 折线）.
  • correlation of two variables → scatter（两变量相关性 → 散点）.
  • use Switch Row/Column to swap rows/columns, Change Chart Type to switch type (e.g. stacked column to see each campus's share)（可用 Switch Row/Column 切换、Change Chart Type 改类型）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ — choose a chart for a combined scenario and justify it (often consolidation-style questions)（选择题：综合场景选择图表并说明理由）.
⚠️ Pitfall: picking a column for a composition ratio; using a line chart for category comparison with no time order（把构成比例误选柱形；折线图用于无时间顺序的类别比较）.

13 Common Functions and Fill Handle（常用函数与填充柄）

In one line: this block is the fundamental core of the Excel final exam; the six functions plus the fill handle and relative/absolute references appear in almost every practical and MCQ, about 20–30% of the Excel section（六大函数与填充柄、相对/绝对引用几乎必现，约占 Excel 部分二到三成）.

Six common functions: SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, COUNTA, MIN, MAX（六大常用函数） 必考

  • all start with an equals sign, with arguments in parentheses; a contiguous range uses a colon A1:A5, multiple non-adjacent areas or cells use commas（以等号开头，括号内为参数；连续区域用冒号，多区域用逗号）.
  • =SUM(A1:A5) sums; =AVERAGE(A1:A5) averages; =MIN(A1:A5) gives the minimum; =MAX(A1:A5) the maximum（求和/平均/最小/最大）.
  • =COUNT(A1:A5) counts only cells holding numbers; =COUNTA(A1:A5) counts all non-empty cells (text, numbers and formula results all count)（COUNT 只数数字；COUNTA 数所有非空）.
  • functions nest inside formulas, e.g. =SUM(A1:A5)-SUM(D1:D5); calculation follows operation order (brackets first, then multiply/divide, then add/subtract)（函数可嵌套；遵循运算次序）.
📝 Exam format: use functions in a summary area for totals/averages/max/min; MCQ distinguishing COUNT from COUNTA（汇总区用函数计算；选择题区分 COUNT 与 COUNTA）.
⚠️ Pitfall: COUNT counts only numbers, ignoring text or blank cells; COUNTA even counts a heading word as one. Do not drop the comma between multiple areas, and do not write a colon as a comma（COUNT 只数数字；COUNTA 连标题也算；多选区域别漏逗号也别把冒号写成逗号）.

Fill handle and AutoFill（填充柄与自动填充序列） 必考

  • after selecting a cell, the small square at its bottom-right is the fill handle; drag to copy formulas, or fill a sequence by pattern (weekdays, months, dates, arithmetic steps)（右下角小方块即填充柄；拖拽复制公式或填充序列）.
  • after dragging, an AutoFill options marker appears; switch to Fill Series, Copy Cells, Fill Formatting Only, etc.（拖拽后出现选项，可改填充序列/复制单元格/仅格式）.
  • for more complex sequences, Home tab → Editing group → Fill → Series, where you set step, weekdays only, monthly increments, etc.（复杂序列用 Fill → Series 设步长等）.
  • Flash Fill auto-splits or merges text once it detects a pattern; the result is not a formula and will not update when source data changes（Flash Fill 结果非公式，源数据变不更新）.
📝 Exam format: practical — use the fill handle to batch-generate date/number sequences or copy formulas down; MCQ on what a fill option does（实操批量生成序列或向下复制公式；选择题判断填充选项用途）.
⚠️ Pitfall: dragging to make a series (1, 2, 3…) may by default copy the same value — pick Fill Series in the AutoFill options. Treating a Flash Fill result as a formula also leaves data un-updated（想生成序列却默认复制同值；把 Flash Fill 当公式导致不更新）.

Absolute vs relative references inside functions（绝对/相对引用在函数中如何配合） 必考

  • relative reference A1: when filled down or right, both row and column shift automatically（相对引用填充时行列自动偏移）.
  • absolute reference $A$1: dollar signs lock both row and column, no shift on fill; mixed reference $A1 or A$1 locks only one dimension（绝对引用锁定行列；混合引用只锁一维）.
  • on Windows, select the reference in the formula and press F4 to cycle the four reference types (Mac: Cmd+T), more reliable than typing dollar signs（选中引用按 F4 切换；Mac 用 Cmd+T）.
  • with functions: when filling down, fixed parameters like unit price or tax rate need absolute reference; cleaner still, define a named range so the named area acts as an absolute reference and is unaffected by moving（固定参数用绝对引用；更简洁地定义 named range 命名区域视为绝对引用）.
  • classic Car Sales case: after filling, B12 became B15, the lookup area shifted and gave wrong results; changing to $B$12 fixes it（Car Sales 案例中 B12 变 B15 错位，改为 $B$12 即可）.
📝 Exam format: find and fix a formula that mis-aligns after fill (add absolute reference); MCQ on how a reference changes after fill（找出并修正下拉后错位的公式；选择题判断填充后变化）.
⚠️ Pitfall: forgetting to lock the lookup area or unit-price cell when filling down, shifting the whole column; hand-typing $ and missing the column or row. Prefer F4 or a named range（下拉忘记锁查找区域或单价；手敲 $ 漏列或行；优先 F4 或 named range）.

14 The IF Function（IF 条件函数）

In one line: IF is the logical backbone of the Excel final practical, often combined with references and lookups in branching calculation tasks; MCQs love testing its syntax and quote rules（IF 是逻辑主干，常结合引用与查找，选择题爱考语法与引号规则）.

IF syntax and its three arguments（IF 语法与三个参数） 必考

  • syntax: =IF(logical_test, value_if_true, value_if_false)（语法）.
  • logical_test is a logical judgement (result TRUE or FALSE); if true it returns value_if_true, otherwise value_if_false（逻辑判断，成立返回真值否则假值）.
  • the return value can be text, a number, another formula, or left blank; when filled down, fixed parameters again use absolute reference or a named range（返回值可为文本/数字/公式或留空；填充时固定参数用绝对引用或 named range）.
  • example: hours over 10 earns a prize =IF(C2>10, "Prize", "No Prize"); department Accounts pays 80 per hour else 60 =IF(D2="Accounts", $C$11, $C$12)（示例）.
📝 Exam format: write an IF formula from a business rule (e.g. different results by department / hours / quantity); MCQ completing the argument order（按业务规则写 IF；选择题补全参数顺序）.
⚠️ Pitfall: reversing the three-argument order (condition first, then true, then false); a text return value without quotes errors out（参数顺序记反；文本返回值忘引号报错）.

Comparison operators（比较运算符） 必考

  • six symbols: = equal, > greater than, >= greater than or equal, < less than, <= less than or equal, <> not equal（六类符号）.
  • combine multiple conditions with AND (and) or OR (or), e.g. =IF(AND(A1>0, A1<10), "范围內", "范围外")（用 AND/OR 组合）.
  • text comparison needs English double quotes, numeric comparison needs none（文本比较加英文双引号，数字比较不加）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ identifying operator meanings; practical — pick the right symbol for a logical test（选择题辨认运算符；实操选用正确符号）.
⚠️ Pitfall: writing not-equal as =! or a lone >; in a Chinese context do not write 大于等于 as =>（不等于别写成 =!；大于等于别写成 =>）.

Nested IF and TRUE/FALSE logic（嵌套 IF 与 TRUE/FALSE 逻辑） 常考

  • nest another IF inside value_if_true or value_if_false to form multiple branches; judge layer by layer, with mutually exclusive and complete intervals（在真值/假值里再套 IF 形成多分支；区间互斥且无遗漏）.
  • TRUE/FALSE: the logical_test result can only be true or false, deciding which branch to take（逻辑判断结果只能真或假）.
  • grading example: =IF(A1>=85, "A", IF(A1>=70, "B", IF(A1>=60, "C", "D")))（分级示例）.
  • with many branches, first write the rule as a decision tree (if…then…else…), then translate it into a formula（分支多时先画决策树再翻译）.
📝 Exam format: multi-level IF returning a grade/discount by score or quantity band; MCQ on which branch a value falls into（按区间返回等级/折扣的多层 IF；选择题判断落入哪一分支）.
⚠️ Pitfall: overlapping or empty intervals send some data to the wrong branch; with many levels, plan first then write（区间重叠或留空导致错误分支；层级多先画决策树）.

Common errors: missing quotes on text, etc.（常见错误：文本未加引号等） 必考

  • a text result or text condition must be wrapped in English double quotes, e.g. =IF(B2="The Lab Depot", total*0.9, total)（文本结果或条件必须加英文双引号）.
  • a reversed condition or wrong operator (e.g. >= written as >) sends boundary values into the wrong branch（条件写反或比较符用错让边界值进错分支）.
  • too many nested levels or intervals not covering all cases will miss data that should be handled（嵌套过多或区间未覆盖全部情况会漏掉数据）.
📝 Exam format: error-fixing — find an unquoted text or a reversed condition; practical — write a correctly quoted formula from a rule（改错题找出未加引号的文本或写反条件；实操正确写带引号公式）.
⚠️ Pitfall: writing text quotes as Chinese 「」 or omitting them makes Excel report a formula error; a numeric result must not be quoted (else it becomes text and cannot calculate)（把文本引号写成中文「」或漏写会报错；数字结果不要加引号否则变文本）.

15 The XLOOKUP Function（XLOOKUP 查找函数）

In one line: XLOOKUP is a must-know lookup function in the final exam, often in practical tasks matching data across sheets by key; MCQs focus on its arguments and match modes（XLOOKUP 必考，常跨表按关键字匹配，选择题重考参数与匹配模式）.

Full arguments and syntax（完整参数与语法） 必考

  • syntax: =XLOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_array, return_array, [if_not_found], [match_mode], [search_mode])（语法）.
  • the first three are required: lookup_value is the value to find (usually a cell reference), lookup_array is the lookup range, return_array is the return range（前三个必填：查找值、查找区域、返回区域）.
  • text arguments use English double quotes, numbers do not: =XLOOKUP("Apple", A2:A10, B2:B10, "未找到")（文本参数加引号，数字不加）.
  • if return_array has multiple columns, the result spills to the adjacent cells on the right, with no second formula needed（多列结果溢出到右侧相邻单元格）.
  • when omitting if_not_found but setting match_mode, leave a placeholder comma at the fourth argument: =XLOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_array, return_array, , -1)（省略第四参数但要写 match_mode 时留占位逗号）.
  • search_mode optional: 1 search from start (default), -1 from end, 2 binary search on ascending lookup_array, -2 on descending lookup_array. Incorrect ordering can return invalid results（2：查找范围须升序；-2：查找范围须降序；顺序不符可能返回无效结果）.
📝 Exam format: return a value by key across sheets (e.g. rent by car model); MCQ completing argument order or recognising spill behaviour（跨表按关键字返回值；选择题补全参数或识别溢出）.
⚠️ Pitfall: lookup_array and return_array must share the same type (text/number); a missing placeholder comma pushes match_mode into the wrong argument slot（两区域类型须一致；占位逗号漏写会让 match_mode 落错参数位）.

Exact match vs approximate match（精确匹配 vs 近似匹配） 必考

  • match_mode 0: exact match (default), returns #N/A if not found; used to look up specific data by key（精确匹配默认，找不到返回 #N/A）.
  • match_mode -1: if not found, returns the largest value not greater than the lookup value (next smaller); 1 returns the next larger; 2 wildcard match（近似：-1 返回不大于查找值的最大值，1 返回下一个更大，2 通配符）.
  • approximate match is often used for interval lookups, e.g. grade by score (53 falls in C) or tax rate by salary band; the lookup table must be sorted ascending（近似匹配常用于区间查表，查找表须升序）.
📝 Exam format: use approximate match to return a grade or discount by interval; MCQ on the meaning of -1 versus 1（用近似匹配按区间返回等级/折扣；选择题判断 -1 与 1 含义）.
⚠️ Pitfall: forgetting to sort lookup_array ascending for an interval lookup, so approximate match picks the wrong row; needing exact but setting -1/1 turns it approximate（区间查表忘升序会取错行；需要精确却误设 -1/1）.

Advantages over VLOOKUP（与 VLOOKUP 相比的优点） 常考

  • free direction: return_array can sit left of lookup_array, whereas VLOOKUP requires the lookup column to be leftmost（方向自由：返回区域可在查找区域左侧，VLOOKUP 要求查找列最左）.
  • exact match by default; VLOOKUP defaults to approximate and needs FALSE for exact（默认精确匹配；VLOOKUP 默认近似必须写 FALSE）.
  • using return_array instead of a column index means inserting or deleting columns will not break the formula (VLOOKUP's index shifts)（用返回区域而非列序号，插入删除列不破坏公式）.
  • the built-in if_not_found customises the not-found message, avoiding #N/A errors（内置 if_not_found 自定义未找到提示，避免 #N/A）.
  • it also supports horizontal data and can return a whole column with spill（还支持横向数据、可返回整列并溢出）.
📝 Exam format: MCQ comparing the two; practical — feel the advantage of not counting column positions（选择题比较差异；实操体会不必数第几列）.
⚠️ Pitfall: assuming XLOOKUP also must start from the leftmost column; forgetting to use if_not_found instead of facing #N/A（误以为 XLOOKUP 也要从最左列查；忘记用 if_not_found 替代 #N/A）.

Common errors（常见错误） 必考

  • match_mode missing or wrong, turning a needed exact match into approximate（match_mode 漏写或写错，需要精确却变近似）.
  • mismatched lookup value type, e.g. a text-formatted number versus a numeric number cannot match（查找值类型不一致，如文本型数字与数值型数字无法匹配）.
  • when filling down, the lookup/return range is not locked, causing the range to shift: use a named range or $ absolute reference（公式下拉时区域未锁定导致偏移；用 named range 或 $ 绝对引用）.
  • the if_not_found text lacks quotes; omitting a middle argument but forgetting the placeholder comma（if_not_found 文本未加引号；省略中间参数却忘留占位逗号）.
📝 Exam format: error-fixing — fix a formula that shifts after fill; MCQ identifying #N/A caused by type mismatch（改错题修正下拉后偏移的公式；选择题识别类型不匹配导致的 #N/A）.
⚠️ Pitfall: writing lookup_value as text while lookup_array holds numbers (or vice versa); an empty row inside the range also breaks the match（lookup_value 文本而 lookup_array 数字或反之；区域含空行也会匹配失败）.

16 Advanced Excel: Nested IF with AND/OR, 3D References, and XLOOKUP Review（嵌套 IF + AND/OR、3D 引用与 XLOOKUP 复习）

This block tests compound conditional logic and cross-sheet calculations — the syntax foundation of advanced Excel that runs through all practical tasks（本块考复合条件判断与跨表计算，是高级 Excel 的语法地基，贯穿所有实操任务）.

Nested IF: multi-branch logic（嵌套 IF 多分支判断） 必考

  • Syntax: =IF(condition, value_if_true, value_if_false); place another IF inside the false branch to build three or more levels（语法：=IF(条件,真值,假值)，在假值里再写 IF 即可实现三层以上分支）.
  • Example: =IF(A1>=90,"优",IF(A1>=75,"良",IF(A1>=60,"及格","不及格"))) grades a score into tiers（示例：按分数分档）.
  • Before coding, list every branch with a decision tree to keep them mutually exclusive and exhaustive; fill in all three arguments of each IF（动手前先用决策树列出所有分支，保证互斥且穷尽；每层 IF 的三个参数都要写全）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice tests predicting a branch result; hands-on asks you to write a multi-tier formula (fare tiers, discount levels, membership categories)（选择题考分支结果判断；实操考写多档位公式：票价档位、折扣等级、会员分类）.
⚠️ Common mistake: wrong boundary (using > where ≥ is needed); overlapping or gapped intervals; unmatched parentheses that break the formula（易错：边界归属写错（该用 ≥ 却用 >）；区间出现重叠或缝隙；括号不配对导致公式报错）.

IF with AND / OR: compound conditions（IF 配合 AND/OR 复合条件） 必考

  • =IF(AND(cond1,cond2,...),true,false): returns true only when all conditions hold（所有条件同时成立才返回真）.
  • =IF(OR(cond1,cond2,...),true,false): returns true if any condition holds（任一条件成立即返回真）.
  • Example: =IF(AND(A1>0,B1<100),"Yes","No"); =IF(OR(C1="急",D1>1000),"优先","普通")（示例：AND 全真才真；OR 任一真即真）.
  • AND / OR can sit inside IF, and mix with multi-level IF (e.g. the Harwood amount-band test)（AND/OR 可嵌在 IF 内，也可与多层 IF 混用）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice asks whether AND or OR fits the meaning; hands-on tests compound business rules (overdue, discount, eligibility)（选择题考该用 AND 还是 OR 的语义；实操考复合业务规则：逾期、折扣、资格）.
⚠️ Common mistake: using OR where AND is needed widens the condition and over-counts; AND/OR accept many conditions yet only one is written（易错：该用 AND 误用 OR 会放宽条件结果多算；AND/OR 里可放多个条件却只写了一个）.

Grouping sheets and 3D references（多工作表分组与 3D 引用） 常考

  • Grouping: hold Shift and click the first and last sheet tabs to edit many sheets together; right-click and choose Ungroup Sheets to stop（按住 Shift 点首尾表标签多表同步编辑；右键选 Ungroup Sheets 取消分组）.
  • 3D reference: =SUM(Sheet1:Sheet4!B2) sums the same cell across several sheets（对同一区域的多个工作表数据求和）.
  • Example: =SUM(Jan:Mar!B5) totals a quarter; pair with grouping to format each branch sheet in bulk（示例：=SUM(Jan:Mar!B5) 汇总一季度；配合分组批量设置各分店表格式）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on 3D reference syntax; hands-on on grouped formatting and 3D totalling of monthly sheets (e.g. the Flights QTR Total)（选择题考 3D 引用语法；实操考分组设格式、用 3D 引用汇总月度表如 Flights 的 QTR Total）.
⚠️ Common mistake: editing while grouped accidentally changes other sheets; reversing the start/end sheets (e.g. Sheet4:Sheet1) yields an empty total（易错：分组状态下编辑误改其他表；起止表顺序写反汇总结果为空）.

XLOOKUP review: cross-sheet lookup（XLOOKUP 跨表查找复习） 必考

  • Syntax: =XLOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_array, return_array, [if_not_found], [match_mode], [search_mode])（语法：查找值、查找数组、返回数组、找不到时、匹配模式、搜索模式）.
  • Unlike VLOOKUP it is free of column order and can look left, so it is a Term 1 focus that stays exam-required in Term 2（比 VLOOKUP 不受列序限制、可向左查，Term 1 重点、Term 2 仍必考）.
  • Example: =XLOOKUP(A2,产品表!A:A,产品表!C:C,"无")（示例：跨表查单价/等级）.
📝 Exam format: hands-on lookup of unit price / level across sheets (e.g. Flights uses XLOOKUP for employee Level, StoreData for stock)（实操考跨工作表查单价/等级如 Flights 取员工 Level、StoreData 查库存）.
⚠️ Common mistake: the lookup and return arrays must share row count; a text vs number key mismatch returns no result（易错：查找数组与返回数组行数需一致；文本型与数值型关键字类型不一致会查不到）.

17 Date Functions and Conditional Statistics: DATE, TODAY, EDATE; COUNTIF, SUMIF, COUNTIFS, SUMIFS（日期函数与条件统计）

This block tests date construction / calculation and conditional counting & summing — the core of time-dimension reporting and statistical analysis（本块考日期构造/计算与带条件的计数求和，是报表时间维度与统计分析的核心）.

DATE / TODAY / EDATE date functions（DATE/TODAY/EDATE 日期函数） 必考

  • =DATE(year,month,day) combines three numbers into a proper date, avoiding text dates that cannot calculate（把三个数字合成标准日期，避免文本日期无法计算）.
  • =TODAY() returns the current date (dynamic); press Ctrl+; to enter a static date（返回当前日期（动态）；按 Ctrl+; 可输入静态日期）.
  • =EDATE(start_date,months) computes a date that many months later, e.g. =EDATE(A1,3) is three months on（计算若干月后的日期，如 =EDATE(A1,3) 为三个月后）.
  • A date is fundamentally a serial number, so subtract directly for the day gap; =TODAY()-birthdate gives age, rounded with INT or ROUNDDOWN; YEAR / MONTH / DAY / WEEKDAY extract year, month, day and weekday（日期本质是序列值，相减得天数；算年龄用 INT/ROUNDDOWN 取整；YEAR/MONTH/DAY/WEEKDAY 提取年月日与星期）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on DATE argument order; hands-on on overdue checks, age calculation, date-range filtering（选择题考 DATE 参数顺序；实操考逾期判断、年龄计算、按日期区间筛选）.
⚠️ Common mistake: a text-entered date cannot calculate or compare; putting the day where the month belongs; forgetting a date format so the result shows as a five-digit serial（易错：日期以文本输入无法计算与比较；参数顺序把日写在月的位置；结果忘设日期格式显示成五位数序列号）.

COUNTIF: single-condition count（COUNTIF 单条件计数） 必考

  • Syntax: =COUNTIF(range,criteria)（语法：范围、条件）.
  • Criteria syntax: =COUNTIF(A1:A10,10) equals 10; =COUNTIF(A1:A10,">40") greater than 40; =COUNTIF(A1:A10,"frog") text match; =COUNTIF(A1:A10,"<"&B1) references a cell condition（criteria 写法：等于 10 / 大于 40 / 文本 / 引用单元格条件）.
  • Example: =COUNTIF($C$3:$E$29,A35) counts how often a sport appears (lock the absolute reference when copying)（示例：统计某运动出现次数，复制时锁绝对引用）.
📝 Exam format: hands-on counting a record type (e.g. flights of an airline, Group course count)（实操考统计某类记录数如某航空公司航班数、Group 课程数）.
⚠️ Common mistake: when a comparison is the criterion, the operator must sit inside quotes and the cell reference is joined with & (e.g. "<"&B1 not "<B1")（易错：比较符要在引号内、单元格引用用 & 连接（如 "<"&B1 而非 "<B1"））.

SUMIF: single-condition sum（SUMIF 单条件求和） 必考

  • Syntax: =SUMIF(range,criteria,sum_range) — one extra sum range argument beyond COUNTIF（比 COUNTIF 多一个求和范围参数）.
  • Example: =SUMIF(airline_column,"Regal",fare_column) sums Regal's fares（示例：汇总 Regal 的票价）.
📝 Exam format: hands-on summing by category (e.g. fares by airline, lesson fees by instrument)（实操考按类别汇总金额如按航空公司的票价、按乐器的课时费）.
⚠️ Common mistake: mismatched sizes between the criteria range and the sum range cause errors; a text criterion must use literal double quotes（易错：条件范围与求和范围大小不一致会出错；文本条件必须加双引号）.

COUNTIFS / SUMIFS: multi-condition statistics（COUNTIFS/SUMIFS 多条件统计） 必考

  • =COUNTIFS(criteria_range1,criteria1,criteria_range2,criteria2,...)（多条件计数）.
  • =SUMIFS(sum_range,criteria_range1,criteria1,criteria_range2,criteria2,...) — note the argument order differs from COUNTIFS!（注意参数顺序与 COUNTIFS 不同）.
  • Example: =SUMIFS(fare_column,airline_column,"Regal",destination_column,"Launceston")（示例：Regal 且 Launceston 的票价）.
  • A date criterion is written as =COUNTIFS(date_column,">="&DATE(2026,3,1),category_column,"A")（日期作条件写法）.
📝 Exam format: hands-on two-condition statistics (Regal and Launceston fares, a date range plus a category)（实操考双条件统计：Regal 且 Launceston 的票价、某日期区间 + 类别）.
⚠️ Common mistake: COUNTIFS lists criteria range then criteria, but SUMIFS lists the sum range first; date criteria need DATE() or ">="&cell, and a text-date criterion fails（易错：COUNTIFS 先条件范围后条件，SUMIFS 先求和范围；日期条件要用 DATE() 或 ">="&单元格，文本日期作条件会失效）.

18 Financial and Text Functions: PMT, FV; LEFT, RIGHT, MID, TEXT, CONCAT, UPPER, LOWER, TRIM, PROPER（财务函数与文本函数）

This block tests loan / investment calculation and string cleaning & merging, common in what-if models and data-cleaning tasks（本块考贷款/投资计算与字符串清洗合并，常出现在 what-if 模型与数据整理任务）.

PMT: periodic loan repayment（PMT 贷款每期还款） 必考

  • Syntax: =PMT(rate,nper,pv,[fv],[type])（语法：利率、期数、现值、未来值、类型）.
  • rate is the per-period rate (annual rate ÷ 12), nper is the total number of periods (years × 12), pv is the present value (loan amount)（rate 是每期利率（年利率 ÷ 12），nper 是总期数（年数 × 12），pv 是现值（贷款额））.
  • Example: =PMT(B3/12,B4*12,-B5) shows the monthly payment as positive; or =-PMT(...)（示例：让月供显示为正数）.
  • Cash-flow sign convention: outflows are negative, inflows positive; the result defaults negative, so use a minus sign or ABS to make it positive（现金流方向：支出为负、收入为正，结果默认负，用负号或 ABS 转正）.
📝 Exam format: hands-on computing the monthly payment (e.g. Vans / Tunes loan sheets, repayments with a deposit)（实操考计算月供如 Vans/Tunes 贷款表、含定金的还款）.
⚠️ Common mistake: feeding the annual rate without ÷12 or the years without ×12; ignoring the sign convention flips the payment sign; type defaults to end-of-period (0)（易错：年利率未除 12、期数未乘 12 直接代入；忽略符号约定导致月供正负颠倒；type 默认期末（0））.

FV: future investment value（FV 投资未来值） 常考

  • Syntax: =FV(rate,nper,pmt,[pv],[type])（语法：利率、期数、每期投入、现值、类型）.
  • Example: =FV(0.045/12,3*12,-1000) is the end value after investing 1000 a month for three years（示例：每月投 1000、三年后终值）.
  • pmt is the per-period contribution, with the same sign convention as PMT（pmt 为每期投入，符号约定与 PMT 一致）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice on FV argument meaning; hands-on on savings / investment future value（选择题考 FV 参数含义；实操考储蓄/投资终值）.
⚠️ Common mistake: confusing pv with pmt; writing the contribution sign backwards makes the result negative（易错：把 pv 与 pmt 混淆；投入金额符号写反导致结果为负）.

Text extraction: LEFT / RIGHT / MID（文本截取 LEFT/RIGHT/MID） 必考

  • =LEFT(text,num_chars), =RIGHT(text,num_chars), =MID(text,start_pos,num_chars) — start position begins at 1（截取函数，起始位置从 1 开始）.
  • Example: first letter of an airline code =UPPER(LEFT(airline,1)); first two letters of a destination =LEFT(destination,2)（示例：航班代码首字母、目的地前两字母）.
📝 Exam format: hands-on splitting names (First Name / Last Name), building a code (airline initial + first two destination letters + flight number)（实操考拆分姓名、构造代码：航空公司首字母 + 目的地前两字母 + 航班号）.
⚠️ Common mistake: counting the start position from 0 instead of 1; wrong length / position shifts the code（易错：起始位置从 1 数而不是 0；截取长度/位置算错导致代码错位）.

Text join and case: TEXT / CONCAT / UPPER / LOWER / TRIM / PROPER（文本合并与大小写） 常考

  • =CONCAT(text1,text2,...) or the & operator joins strings; a space is written explicitly as " "（合并文本；空格用 " " 显式表示）.
  • =UPPER() upper-case, =LOWER() lower-case, =PROPER() capitalises the first letter; =TRIM(text) removes extra spaces（大小写转换；TRIM 去除多余空格）.
  • =TEXT(value,"format_code") displays a number as text (e.g. weekday or month name)（把数值显示为文本：星期/月份名）.
  • Example: =PROPER(姓)&"."&PROPER(名)&"@vance.com.au" builds an email (reference the domain from the reference area with an absolute reference)（示例：生成邮箱，域名用绝对引用）.
📝 Exam format: hands-on generating emails, joining the 「LAST NAME - First Name」 format, unifying name case（实操考生成邮箱、拼接 LAST NAME - First Name 格式、统一姓名大小写）.
⚠️ Common mistake: CONCAT does not add spaces automatically, so write " " explicitly; TRIM only removes leading/trailing and extra between-word spaces, not a single mid-string space（易错：CONCAT 需显式加 " "；TRIM 只去首尾及词间多余空格）.

19 Advanced Charts: Combo Chart, Secondary Axis, Sparklines, and High-end Formatting（高级图表：组合图、次坐标轴、迷你图、图表高级格式化）

This block tests dual-axis combo charts, trendlines and sparklines — the high-mark practical tasks in data visualisation（本块考双轴组合图、趋势线与迷你图，是数据可视化里的高分操作题）.

Combo chart and secondary axis（组合图 combo chart 与次坐标轴 secondary axis） 必考

  • When two series differ greatly in scale (e.g. sales vs growth rate), columns use the primary axis and the line uses the secondary axis: insert Combo > Clustered Column – Line on Secondary Axis（量纲差异大时柱形走主轴、折线走次轴：插入 Combo > Clustered Column – Line on Secondary Axis）.
  • Right-click a data series → Format Data Series → Secondary Axis; or change the chart type to set one series as a line（右键数据系列 → 次坐标轴；或更改图表类型为折线）.
  • Example: in the SOI table, temperature/SOI are columns (primary) and rainfall is a marked line (secondary)（示例：SOI 表温度/SOI 为柱（主轴）、降雨为折线带标记（次轴））.
📝 Exam format: hands-on dual-axis combo chart (e.g. Weekday/Weekend traffic, Budget/Business price + % difference)（实操考做双轴组合图如 Weekday/Weekend 客流、Budget/Business 价 + % 差）.
⚠️ Common mistake: using a dual axis when scales are close misleads readers; forgetting to push a series to the secondary axis flattens the small values; the secondary axis scale needs its own setting（易错：量纲相近却用双轴造成误读；忘记把某系列设到次轴导致小值被压扁；次轴刻度需单独设置）.

Trendline and scatter plot（趋势线 trendline 与散点图） 常考

  • An X-Y Scatter chart shows the correlation of two numeric variables; both axes are numeric and must carry axis titles; the trendline needs a legend stating its type（散点图展示两数值变量相关性，两轴皆数值，必须加轴标题；趋势线配图例显示类型）.
  • A linear trendline shows steady increase/decrease, a moving average shows a smoothed path; you can display the equation and R² value（线性趋势线看稳定增减，移动平均看平滑走势；可显示公式与 R²）.
📝 Exam format: hands-on scatter plot with a trendline (e.g. Property price vs income)（实操考散点图加趋势线如 Property 房价 vs 收入）.
⚠️ Common mistake: wrong trendline type (linear on exponential data); forgetting axis titles on a scatter plot（易错：趋势线类型选错（指数数据套线性）；散点图忘记加轴标题）.

Advanced chart formatting（图表高级格式化） 必考

  • Marker size (≥ 5 / 8 / 10 / 12 pts), line width (≥ 5 pts), dashed / smoothed line, data labels (only the tallest column at 16 pts), title font (≥ 24 pts italic), legend / axis titles ≥ 16 pts（标记点大小、线宽、虚线、数据标签、标题字体、图例/轴标题的尺寸规范）.
  • Move the chart to its own chart sheet (Move Chart → New sheet) and name it, e.g. June Chart（移动图表到单独图表工作表并命名）.
  • Set axis Bounds manually for min/max; rotate labels 270°; use a filter to show only part of the data（轴边界手动设最小/最大；标签旋转 270°；筛选只显示部分数据）.
📝 Exam format: hands-on precise formatting to match a sample image (colour is not graded; size / position / title matter)（实操考按样图精确格式化：颜色不重要，尺寸/位置/标题重要）.
⚠️ Common mistake: too many data labels overlap; chart not moved to a chart sheet or named wrong; editing the formatted number on the cell instead of only the chart axis（易错：数据标签过多互相重叠；图表未移到图表工作表或命名不符；把格式数字改在单元格而非仅图表轴上）.

Sparklines（迷你图 sparklines） 了解

  • Insert → Sparklines (Line / Column / Win-Loss) show a trend inside a single cell without a full chart（迷你图：在单个单元格内显示趋势，不需完整图表）.
  • Use them beside a row/column to show a quick trend, ideal for compact reports（适合紧凑报表快速展示走势）.
📝 Exam format: multiple-choice may ask the sparkline location (inside a cell) and its three types（选择题可能考迷你图位置（在单元格内）与三种类型）.
⚠️ Common mistake: sparkline source data must be continuous; blank values break the trend line（易错：迷你图源数据范围需连续，空值会断开走势）.

20 Advanced Excel Exam Structure and Question Types（Advanced Excel 考试结构与真题类型）

This block reviews the exam format (a 30-minute, 30-question Moodle quiz worth 20% of Term 2 / 10% overall) and the recurring hands-on question types and strategies revealed by the practice exam（梳理考试形式与练习考暴露的常考实操题型与策略）.

Exam format and scope（考试形式与范围） 必考

  • A 30-minute Moodle quiz of 30 randomised multiple-choice questions that auto-submits when time is up; held in Challenge Week; worth 20% of Term 2 (10% of total)（30 分钟 30 道随机选择题，自动提交；Challenge Week 进行；占 Term 2 的 20% / 总评 10%）.
  • Coverage: AND/OR compound conditions, 3D references, DATE, SUMIF/COUNTIFS, PMT/FV, text functions, plus Term 1's IF and XLOOKUP（覆盖范围：AND/OR、3D 引用、DATE、SUMIF/COUNTIFS、PMT/FV、文本函数及 Term 1 的 IF 与 XLOOKUP）.
  • Use the Week 6 Practice Exam Quiz to drill repeatedly; for wrong answers, revisit the matching Learning Guide（用 Week 6 练习测验反复刷，错题回看 Learning Guide）.
📝 Exam format: the multiple-choice quiz itself; also tests facts like duration / weight / auto-submit（选择题本身；也会考考试时长/分值/自动提交等事实）.
⚠️ Common mistake: unfamiliarity with the platform; no manual extension on timeout, so watch the top-right timer closely（易错：不熟悉平台操作；超时无手动延长，务必盯紧右上角计时器）.

Recurring hands-on types from the practice exam (AIR / Flights / Tunes)（练习考反映的常考实操题型） 必考

  • File & page: save as a ZID-prefixed filename; put Name, Class, ZID and the auto filename in header/footer; set the page to landscape（另存为 ZID 前缀文件名；页眉/页脚放 Name、Class、ZID、自动文件名；页面横向）.
  • Formatting: insert rows, merge & centre, dark fill with white text, font ≥ 20 / 25, bold/italic, currency / percentage format, borders, wrap text, do not hide data（插入行、合并居中、深色填充+白字、字号≥20/25、加粗斜体、货币/百分比格式、边框、自动换行、不隐藏数据）.
  • Calculated columns (absolute references): fare = distance × unit price, discount price, surcharge, membership discount (build a reference area with absolute references)（计算列：票价=距离×单价、折扣价、附加费、会员折扣，用绝对引用参考区）.
  • Conditional formulas: IF/AND/OR for airport fee, roof rack, vegetarian-meal ratio, insurance (Elite or > $12000 → 11%, else 0)（条件公式：IF/AND/OR 做机场费、屋顶架、素食餐比例、保险）.
  • Summary functions: COUNTIF to count (by airline), SUMIFS for two-condition sums (Regal and Launceston), MAX/MIN extremes, XLOOKUP to look up level / unit price（COUNTIF 计数、SUMIFS 双条件求和、MAX/MIN、XLOOKUP 查等级/单价）.
  • Text functions: build a code (first letter + first two letters of destination + flight number, UPPER), split names, join 「LAST NAME - First Name」（文本函数：构造代码、拆分姓名、拼接 LAST NAME - First Name）.
  • Grouping & 3D references: group monthly sheets; use a 3D reference for the QTR Total（分组月度表、QTR Total 用 3D 引用汇总）.
